scope: Focused physical thread contact and worker integration tests; not a completed suture or full project suite

cuda.command: PYTHONPATH=tests NEWTON_TEST_DEVICE=cuda:0 uv run --locked python -m unittest test_thread_rigid_contact test_worker_thread -v
cuda.command_note: Equivalent public command. Executed via unittest discovery harness with Warp kernel cache redirected to /tmp/suturebot_thread_rigid_cuda_cache and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.

cpu_regression.command: PYTHONPATH=tests NEWTON_TEST_DEVICE=cpu uv run --locked python -m unittest test_thread_contact test_thread_solver test_thread_tissue test_suture_stitches test_thread_rigid_contact test_worker_thread -v
cpu_regression.command_note: Equivalent public command. Executed via unittest discovery harness with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, cache in /tmp/suturebot_thread_rigid_cpu_cache and BLAS/OMP threads1.

checks: Two distinct jaws retain simultaneous contact planes
Actual ANCF solve recovers a specified initially penetrating fixture without projection
Moving and rotating body friction anchors
Fresh equal/opposite force and common-origin torque
Worker force feedback and independent state
Renderer-like position reads and add_forces do not advance thread history
limitations: Compliant discrete chord/capsule contacts, not continuous collision detection or exact nonpenetration
One contact per element and body/radius group
Coulomb bound and applied reaction loads are lagged
No worker eyelets, insertion passage or completed suturing certified
